notes.title: Chamber's Reunion 1.4
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello guys![/b][/h1]

I am happy to say that we just released new version of [b]Chamber's Reunion[/b]. There is not much of new content but, still there is some, we added new GUI features, sounds, and short introduction to what happens in the game. So if I was you, I would download the new update and replay this game once again.

notes.title: UPDATE 1.3 + CHAPTER 2 INFO
notes.content:
[b][h1]CHAPTER ONE[/h1][/b]
Hello, I am happy to say that new update is here, with this update we added few new things..

[b][h2]GAMEPLAY[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*] Added new [u]Journal System[/u] to help you navigate in the game
[*] Added a feature to skip the cutscene at the start of the game
[*] Added a UI overhaul (mainly for Journal System)
[/list]

[b][h2]BUGS[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where Enemy Chase would not trigger if player didnt look at the enemy
[/list]

[b][h2]DISCORD[/h2][/b]
Also I would like to remind that we have a [url=https://discord.gg/xTa78ZPSKr]Discord[/url] Server, where you can talk about our games, leave feedback and more..

notes.content:

notes.title: CHAPTER ONE
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello[/b][/h1]
We are here to say that today you can play Chapter One. Experience awesome graphics and story telling.

notes.title: BECOMING FREE
notes.content:
[h1][b]Dear Players[/b][/h1]

We are here to announce that [b]Chamber's Reunion[/b] will become free. We decided to split this game into [b]3 chapters[/b]. Currently you can play the first chapter for free in the next few days. We are also currently working on the new chapters, and those ones will be paid, we are planning that both chapters should cost about 5-10$

[h2]Q&A[/h2]
[olist]
[*] [b]What if I purchased the game before going free?[/b] - We take it as support for our little studio, also we are planning on giving those who purchased our game some extra content in some way.
[*] [b]When we will see another chapter?[/b] - We can't say anything yet, but we are working 100% a day, also we are working on some other projects.
[*] [b]Is there a support for another languagues?[/b] - Yes! We currently support: English, Czech. We are also working on other translations such as: Spanish, German, French.
[/olist]

notes.title: Preview 1.3
notes.content:
Hello, after a little longer development the game got a a completly new design. First of all the game has been rebuilded from start on a Unreal Engine 5. In the next few months the game will recive a lot of updates, because this is just a preview.

Controls:

-WSAD - Move
- Mouse - Look around
- E - Enter Vehicle
- Space Bar - Exit Vehicle

notes.title: Chamber's Reunion Update Is Here
notes.content: The Big Update, that you have been waiting for is here, changes to the map, to ai, to player, to items and much more. I am happy to say that the game looks fire, achivements are also fixed and try to get special Speedrun achivements for finishing the game under some time. So what are you waiting for try it now

notes.title: Chamber's Reunion is Back
notes.content:
Exciting news for all Chamber's Reunion fans! A major update is set to be released in just a couple of weeks, bringing with it a host of new features and improvements that will make the game even more enjoyable to play.

One of the biggest changes in this update is the new storyline, which is sure to captivate players and keep them engaged throughout the game. With an immersive and thrilling plot, players will find themselves on the edge of their seats as they navigate through the game's challenging levels and encounter new enemies and allies.

The graphics have also been given a major overhaul, with new 4K textures that bring the game's environments and characters to life in stunning detail. The improved visuals provide an even more immersive experience, making the game feel like a true work of art.

But that's not all - the update also includes a host of gameplay improvements, such as new abilities and power-ups that will help players overcome obstacles and defeat enemies with even more ease. The controls have also been refined for a smoother, more intuitive experience that makes it easier to focus on the game's action-packed gameplay.

Overall, this update is set to take Chamber's Reunion to the next level, providing players with a more engaging and visually stunning experience than ever before. So mark your calendars and get ready to dive back into the world of Chamber's Reunion in just a few short weeks!
